{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led an Imperial '''assault''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. During the attack, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorin Se'ol]] distracted the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] long enough for a small group of the former's students to escape Volik before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] perished.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The assault on Volik was first mentioned in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was developed by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. ''The Unknown Regions'' was written by [[Sterling Hershey]], [[Rodney Thompson]], and [[Daniel Wallace]], and was published in [[2010]].<ref name="TUR" />
